Messages.Author: Anatol Sendker
Messages.Body:
Hi all,
I have a question about a situation that occured in our playgroup tonight.

Sheldon had a "Secure Haven" played on him by his controller and in the next
round he played "The Rack" on him. Now can I steal the Rack _directly_ from
the Controller (i.e. the Methuselah) or is it considered being a D action
against Sheldon and is therefore impossible? I'd go with the first (can
steal anyway) option but I'm not entirely sure and would therefore
appreciate any comments.

Goodnight,
Anatol.

Messages.Author: Raille
Messages.Body:


Well you paraphrased the racks card text. The Rack only Targets a
vampire, it does not get put on the vampire. As such the Secure haven
has no effect on your ability to steal the rack.

Raille

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. But note that even if it were placed on the Secured vampire, it
could still be stolen - Secure Haven only protects the minion, not the
cards on him.
